corrections.was: sub+11E8h, which sets the approach throttle's bias, is seeded to zero by 009E5530 and written by the unread nested update. Its play-time value is unknown.
corrections.is: sub+11E8h is nested+11E0h, the planar range from the unit's world position to the attackmove destination (brain+0B2Ch, brain+0B34h). 009F1BC0 writes it every frame.
corrections.evidence: 009F1C45 reads the unit's world x/z at +0FCh/+104h into the stack; 009F1C6A and 009F1C74 read brain+0B2Ch and brain+0B34h; 009F1C7E..009F1CAC forms (goal.x-unit.x)^2 + 0*0 + (goal.z-unit.z)^2 with a float store; 009F1CBA compares it against 1e-10 (00CE3820) and takes 00BF7030 sqrt only on the greater side; 009F1CDE stores the result to nested+11E0h. With sub = nested - 8 that is sub+11E8h, so 009F3240's throttle is 2 * ([unit+494h] + 500 - range) clamped to [0, 1000].

corrections.was: nested+11F8h is a ring slot index, which makes the wrap at 009E756E and the reset at 009E75AD meaningful
corrections.is: nested+11F8h is a BEARING in (-pi, pi]. Its only producers are 009E7C28, which stores slot.angle_08 of the winning slot, and 009E7EA6, which stores a heading from atan2. Consequently (int)(30.0 + bearing) is always in [26, 33], the ADD EAX,-3Ch at 009E756E can never run, and |(float)nested+1200h - nested+11F8h| is always about 30, so the 12.0f reset window at 009E75AD is never entered.
corrections.evidence: 009E7C19 IMUL ESI,ESI,0x4C then 009E7C1C MOVSS XMM1,[ESI + EBP + 0xC]: nested + index*4Ch + 0Ch is slot+8h, the bearing 009E5530 writes at 009E56F9. 009E7C28 stores that into nested+11F8h. 009E7EA6 stores the heading built at 009E7DB2..009E7DDD.

uncertainties: Every float expression was transcribed from the listing, but the image computes in x87 80-bit registers with double memory operands. The C++ projection uses double and rounds to float at the same stores the image does; the two agree to float precision on ordinary inputs and are not bit-identical in general. Nothing here is fixture-tested against the image.
tune = [brain+0AB0h] is read at +0h, +4h, +8h, +0Ch, +10h, +14h, +18h and +1Ch by five routines in this packet. No producer was found, so the field names in the header are roles inferred from use.

unit+538h: this packet did not settle its class, but it adds evidence. 0082ADC0 is called on it at 009F1E77 and 009F23DC and reaches BSP_AvoidZoneManager_GetSingleton (004218E0), and [unit+538h]+570h is compared at 009F1E60 against an avoid-zone group id obtained from the target's zone object. So the component carries avoid-zone data as well as the armament readiness 009F3240 tests. The constructor and vtable were not read.

The wobble at 009E7C3E..009E7C78 is dead in two independent ways: the amplitude at 00D7A258 is the double 0.0 and the wrapped result is popped without a store. It is reproduced as a comment, not as code.
No run-time evidence was gathered. bsp_game.exe does not implement any host in this packet, so none of these paths was exercised in a run log.
009E9190's candidate walk is a linked-list traversal with std::list debug checks (00BF6713). The projection models it as an indexed walk over the host; the order is the list's order, not an array's.
